title: Platinum Rewards Card: Earning 4% Cash Back
summary: Explains how the Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases, how returns/credits reduce rewards per transaction, which transactions are eligible/ineligible, and when rewards become available after posting/clearing return windows. Also covers redeeming after $15 and factoring in the $200.00 annual fee.
faqs: How much cash back does the Platinum Rewards Card earn on eligible purchases?
Which transactions are not eligible for cash back (e.g., cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest)?
Do returns or credits affect previously earned rewards? If so, how?
When do rewards accrue and when do they become available after a purchase?
What is the minimum rewards balance required to redeem, and how can I redeem?
How should I account for the $200.00 annual fee when planning purchases?
